content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 531 Clerk (Common Cadre) posts are available under this recruitment, based on demand letters received from various Punjab Government departments. A detailed department-wise and category-wise breakup is provided in the official Annexure to the corrigendum.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualification, to be assessed as on the last date of application submission: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university or institution, or its equivalent At least a 120-hour course with working experience in the use of Personal Computers/Information Technology in Office Productivity Applications or Desktop Publishing Applications from a Government-recognized or ISO 9001-certified institution, OR a Computer/Information Technology course equivalent to the 'O' level certificate of DOEACC, Government of India Matriculation-level Punjabi or an equivalent qualification, as required under Rule 17 of the Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994 A mandatory qualifying test of Punjabi Language equivalent to Matriculation standard, with a minimum of 50% marks, conducted in addition to the competitive examination

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Salary
content_sections.text: The Clerk post carries a pay scale of Level-2, Pay ₹19,900/-, as per the pay scales notified for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances, and no fee waiver or exemption is granted to any candidate.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on 01.01.2026: Minimum age: 18 years for all categories General category: maximum 37 years SC and BC candidates who are residents of Punjab: maximum 42 years State and Central Government employees: maximum 45 years Ex-servicemen (residents of Punjab): as per the Punjab Recruitment of Ex-Servicemen Rules, 1982, as amended from time to time Physically Handicapped candidates (residents of Punjab): maximum 47 years (10 years' relaxation) Widows, divorcees, and certain other categories of married women: relaxation up to 40 years Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Selection Process
content_sections.text: An objective-type (Multiple Choice Questions) written examination will be held in two parts — Part A and Part B Part A: Matriculation-level Punjabi Language paper, of qualifying nature only; a minimum of 50% marks is required to qualify Part B: The merit list is prepared based only on marks obtained in Part B; each question carries 1 mark, and 1/4 mark is deducted for each wrong answer A Typing Test in English and Punjabi at a speed of 30 words per minute will be conducted on computer for candidates called as per the competent authority's decision; the Punjabi typing test will be in Unicode-compliant Raavi font The typing test is of qualifying nature only and must be qualified The Common Merit List is prepared based on Part-B marks of candidates who qualify the typing test In case of a tie in merit, preference is given first by date of birth (older candidate ranked higher), then by percentage of marks in the required educational qualification, and then by Matriculation marks Shortlisted candidates will be called for counseling/document verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PSSSB Clerk Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at sssb.punjab.gov.in and click on the "Apply Online" link New candidates should click "Registration" and fill in their details to generate a User ID and Password Login using the registered User ID and proceed with the online application Fill in personal, educational, and other required details accurately and completely Upload a passport-size photograph (or capture a live photo) and a scanned copy of the signature Click "Save Draft" or "Next" to proceed Click "Attach Annexure" and upload scanned copies of the 10th-class certificate, educational qualification certificates, and other mandatory documents, then click "Save Documents" Click "Make Payment" and pay the applicable fee online Click "Submit" to complete the application, and take a printout of the submitted Application Form for future reference

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Clerk Important Links
content_sections.text: Candidates holding a Bachelor's degree can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Clerk Jobs available across India. Those looking for opportunities within the state can check more Punjab Government Jobs across various departments, while candidates near Mohali can browse SAS Nagar Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies.

faq.question: Q1. Has PSSSB Clerk Recruitment 2026 been reopened?
faq.answer: Yes. PSSSB has reopened online applications for Clerk posts under Advertisement No. 02/2026 via a corrigendum dated 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reopened application window?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 August 2026 to 7 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Do candidates who already applied need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who submitted their application during the original window (13 February 2026 to 6 March 2026) do not need to reapply.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for PSSSB Clerk?
faq.answer: A total of 531 Clerk (Common Cadre) posts are available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in any discipline, along with a 120-hour computer/IT course (or DOEACC 'O' level equivalent) and Matriculation-level Punjabi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for PSSSB Clerk?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years; maximum 37 years for General category, with relaxations up to 47 years for specific categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹1,000 for General category, ₹250 for SC/BC/EWS, ₹200 for Ex-servicemen and dependents, and ₹500 for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: By registering and applying through the "Apply Online" link on sssb.punjab.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A written examination in two parts (qualifying Punjabi paper and a merit-based paper), followed by a qualifying typing test and document verification/counseling.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: Level-2, Pay ₹19,900/- per month.
